name: Sleep
description: Night's rest, usually in the household's shared sleeping space.

name: Rise and dress
description: Rising, washing, dressing and stirring the hearth.

name: Prayer
description: Private devotion or attendance at a short service.

name: Hear Mass
description: Attending Mass at the parish church.

name: Divine Office
description: One of the canonical hours sung in choir.

name: Field work
description: Ploughing, sowing, weeding, harvesting or carting on the open fields.

name: Workshop labour
description: Labour at a trade in the workshop.

name: Manual labour
description: Gardening, copying or upkeep performed as part of a rule of life.

name: Dinner
description: The main meal of the day, taken around midday.

name: Household chores
description: Fetching water and fuel, tending animals, brewing, mending.

name: Attend market
description: Buying and selling at the weekly market.

name: Leisure
description: Rest, conversation, games or the alehouse.
